import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br;
        PrintWriter out;
        boolean var_for_sublime = false;

        if (var_for_sublime) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader("input.txt"));
            out = new PrintWriter(new FileWriter("output.txt"));
        } else {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        }

        // Helper functions
        String giveString() throws IOException {
            return br.readLine().trim();
        }

        List<Integer> giveList() throws IOException {
            String[] parts = giveString().split(" ");
            List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String p : parts) {
                list.add(Integer.parseInt(p));
            }
            return list;
        }

        int giveInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(giveString());
        }

        long modPow(long a, long p) {
            long ans = 1;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    ans = (ans * a) % MOD;
                }
                p >>= 1;
                a = (a * a) % MOD;
            }
            return ans;
        }

        long facCal(int n) {
            long ans = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                ans = (ans * i) % MOD;
            }
            return ans;
        }

        // Generate permutations of [1,2,3,4,5,6]
        List<int[]> permutations = new ArrayList<>();
        generatePermutations(new int[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, 0, permutations);

        int t = 1; // as in original code, t is set to 1
        for (int _ = 0; _ < t; _++) {
            int n = giveInt();
            List<Integer> aList = giveList();
            List<Integer> bList = giveList();

            int a1 = aList.get(0), a2 = aList.get(1), a3 = aList.get(2);
            int b1 = bList.get(0), b2 = bList.get(1), b3 = bList.get(2);

            int mx = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
            int temp = 0;

            for (int[] per : permutations) {
                int ta1 = a1, ta2 = a2, ta3 = a3;
                int tb1 = b1, tb2 = b2, tb3 = b3;
                int tmx = 0;

                for (int el : per) {
                    int t1;
                    switch (el) {
                        case 1:
                            t1 = Math.min(ta1, tb1);
                            ta1 -= t1;
                            tb1 -= t1;
                            tmx += t1;
                            break;
                        case 2:
                            t1 = Math.min(ta1, tb3);
                            ta1 -= t1;
                            tb3 -= t1;
                            tmx += t1;
                            break;
                        case 3:
                            t1 = Math.min(ta2, tb2);
                            ta2 -= t1;
                            tb2 -= t1;
                            tmx += t1;
                            break;
                        case 4:
                            t1 = Math.min(ta2, tb1);
                            ta2 -= t1;
                            tb1 -= t1;
                            tmx += t1;
                            break;
                        case 5:
                            t1 = Math.min(ta3, tb3);
                            ta3 -= t1;
                            tb3 -= t1;
                            tmx += t1;
                            break;
                        case 6:
                            t1 = Math.min(ta3, tb2);
                            ta3 -= t1;
                            tb2 -= t1;
                            tmx += t1;
                            break;
                    }
                }
                if (tmx > temp) {
                    temp = tmx;
                }
            }
            out.print((n - temp) + " ");
            out.println(mx);
        }

        br.close();
        out.close();
    }

    static void generatePermutations(int[] arr, int index, List<int[]> perms) {
        if (index == arr.length) {
            perms.add(arr.clone());
            return;
        }
        for (int i = index; i < arr.length; i++) {
            swap(arr, i, index);
            generatePermutations(arr, index + 1, perms);
            swap(arr, i, index);
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }
}
